Can you help me with this exchange?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **the email address used for your order** (or your **first name, last name, and zip code** if you don’t remember the email).

Also, to set up the exchange correctly, please tell me:
1) The **order id** (it looks like `#W0000000`)  
2) Whether the order is already marked **Delivered** (if you’re not sure, just share the order id and I’ll check)  
3) Which **earbud item** you want to exchange (if there are multiple earbuds, tell me which one)
